Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92594 AC 2; UAT 3.6; UAT TC-13 day-2 reopen · “Hospital shows today and yesterday only. Nursing Home shows the last two visits (UAT 3.6)”.

Bug B35 · S2 · known

Nursing Home keeps the last three visits' transcripts instead of two (TFA-92594 AC 2, UAT 3.6)

Tickets: TFA-92594 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Re-filed from D6 on 2026-10-14 (Quinn). One constant: SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3 in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-16/S11

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S14 Manual aging walk on the server clock: Hospital day 1 → 2 → 3 with real recordings; Nursing Home visits 1 → 4 weeks apart

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U6a Hospital, the part of 'today and yesterday only' that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12: on server day D, no bedside recording from D-4 or earlier is listed (archived as '(prior)' or left … (UAT 3.6; TFA-92594 AC 2; UAT TC-13 (day-2 reopen))
  • U6b Hospital edges that depend on Q1 (calendar day vs hour windows: a D-2 or D-3 recording), Q10 (36 h vs 54 h in all for typed dictation: a row archived 35 h ago) and Q12 (prototype per-stay history vs … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-92594 AC 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U7 Nursing Home: transcripts are kept for the last two visits. (UAT 3.6; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. … (UAT 3.8)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Aging helper (server-clock offset) on the local stack and a browser whose clock follows it. Hospital patient: day 1 bedside recording and typed encounter notes; the physician reopens the chart on day 2 and day 3 (server days). Nursing Home resident seen on four visits a week apart, each with dictated visit text

When Hospital: on day 2 record again and open the panel; on day 3 open it without recording. Nursing Home: after each visit's 12 h window has passed, open the Encounter tab

Then Day 2: day 1 is listed on its own as yesterday, with the right date, and no archive button is tapped; the typed day-1 note is gone from the working box and listed (TC-13 day-2 reopen). Day 3: day 1 is gone and day 2 is listed as yesterday. Nursing Home: after V1: V1; after V2: V1, V2; after V3: V2, V3 only; after V4: V3, V4 only

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1 (no manual step), U6a (day 2), U6b (day 3: calendar vs hours is Q1, prototype vs AC 2 is Q12; judged after those answers), U7 (the real walk; the count rule itself is seeded in S11), T2 (row date = the recording's day), U9 (server day; whose day is Q9). Everything that needs no server-day move is seeded in S10, S11, S17 and S18

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment local · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

After a resident's third and fourth visits the Encounter tab still lists three visits (V1–V3, then V2–V4) instead of the last two.

Evidence: Allure 6678b490, manual TIME lane: 8 of 12 cells passed. The only failing cells are the NH U7 visit-count cells, with the same root as the dev result TC-16/S11 (SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3). The lane ties it to TFA-94699 (in progress). Recorded only, under Q1/Q12: on day 3 the day-1 '(prior)' recording is still listed because it has no archivedAt. The Hospital day 1→2 cells pass.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-16/S11; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.
